profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at CodeDev Group: The Unreal Guys | The Performance Guys | Full Spectrum Interactive
profile.summary: Specialties: Graphics and optimization programming. PC and Console. Open to interesting contract work.

company.name: CodeDev Group: The Unreal Guys | The Performance Guys | Full Spectrum Interactive

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mafia: The Old Country (Windows, PS5, Xbox Series) by Hangar 13 Games. 
* Graphics engineering co-development, including some engine-level customizations of Unreal 5.

positions.title: Lead Graphics Engineer
positions.description:
Concord (PS5, Windows)
* Engine-level customization of Unreal 5 for features and performance on PS5.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
The Witness (PS4, XBox One, Windows, Mac, iOS). 
* One of four engineers that created a multi-platform game, including a custom engine and tools, from scratch.
* Graphics engine, shaders, particle systems, custom effects, editor tools, pathfinding, raycasting, software occlusion system, optimization, HDR support, prototype GL and DX12 backends, a million other things.

Braid Anniversary Edition
* Made engine frame-rate agnostic without affecting classic gameplay.
* Commentary and replay system
* New data build pipeline for updated HD and SD art on multiple platforms
* Many particle system improvements
* A ton of other things and optimizations across the whole engine

Unnamed upcoming game, prototypes and R&D
* Prototype inventory and conversation systems for RPG-style game.
* Lots of other R&D, including some ML
* Work on tools and engine for unnamed game in proprietary Jai programming language

positions.title: Software Lead
positions.description:
Socom 4 : US Navy Seals (PS3)
* Integrated SCEE SPU-post effects solution (heavy PPU-RSX-SPU synchronization work) and converted all post effect shaders to spu/si intrinsics or assembly with in-house scheduler.
* “Ubershader” to generate many material permutations with from one point of maintenance.
* Artist-controlled region culling. Objects are attached to arbitrarily shaped regions culled by SPU.
* Kept renderer and post-effects compatible with SPU-based 3DTV solution.
* Lots of optimization, lots of porting PPU code/data to SPU.
* SPU SSAO prototype.
* Specialized rendering for “scoped-in” sniper views.

MAG (PS3)
* Developed PS3 graphics engine from scratch (and GL-based reference engine on PC)
* Material system supporting any number of Cg shaders, including Maya plugin and Collada-based exporter, data compiler.
* Material shaders and runtime lighting.
* GPU post effects (bloom, tonemapping, depth-of-field, color adjustment, filmgrain, fog, light-scattering)
* GPU Command buffer built entirely on SPU
* Replaced hardware MSAA with SCEE SPU MLAA solution in post-release patch. This was mostly PPU-RSX-SPU synchronization work.
* Specialized rendering for first-person weapons.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Oddworld: Stranger’s Wrath (Xbox)
* New material features including detail maps and normal-mapped specular reflections
* Volumetric water density effect
* Special rendering effects for boss characters (force field, lasers beams, ghost forms)
* Batched decorator render implemented with matrix palettes
* Oblique Frustum Clipping method to clip dynamic geometry in water reflection render
* Assisted with vertex shader-based particle system
* Prototyped additional gameplay elements (player-controlled turrets, jet-ski boat physics) for unreleased title

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
Colin McRae Rally 2005 (Xbox, PS2)
* Xbox graphics lead until my departure.
* Xbox graphics pipeline optimizations including precompiled pushbuffers
* Car damage effects (masked multi-texturing for paint flaking/scratches)
* Post-production effects (motion blur, HDR bloom, depth-of-field)
* Bidirectional ambient lighting
* Environment shadows using shadow maps
* Prototyped bump mapped specular reflections and volumetric fog

Colin McRae Rally 04 (Xbox, PS2)
* Xbox graphics pipeline redesign and optimisation
* Memory use management and optimisation
* Car dirt accumulation effects
* Car reflection mapping
* Environmental specular reflection effects
* Weather and lighting effects
* Xbox HD data caching
* Responsible for Xbox DVD burns

Pro Race Driver (PC, Xbox, PS2)
* Group lead, then acting lead programmer of the 15-strong engineering team
* Scheduling, code reviews, bug triage
* Graphics and optimisation for both PS2 and Xbox
* Scene management system

TOCA World Touring Cars (PSX)
* Started work as a graduate programmer and was involved in many areas of the code: menus, state system, car damage, car decals, UI, sound, graphics, particles.
* By the end of the project I was a group lead in charge of four other engineers.
